sources.title: What Do We Really Know about the History of the Wok? — Rachel Laudan

notes: 炒锅精确发明年不详；新石器时代已有陶釜，铁器时代后才有铁锅。本条目以宋代铸铁炒锅普及为主年份，来源偏弱。
notes_en: The precise invention year is unknown; pottery cauldrons existed in the Neolithic, and iron woks appeared after the advent of the Iron Age. This entry uses the spread of cast-iron woks in the Song dynasty as the primary milestone; sourcing is weak.
summary_zh: 炒锅由中国圜底锅演化而来，精确发明年不详；宋代起铸铁炒锅在日常烹饪中普及，成为爆炒核心炊具。
summary_en: The wok evolved from Chinese round-bottomed pots; no single invention year is known. Cast-iron household woks became common in the Song dynasty and anchored stir-fry cooking.
summary_ja: 中華鍋は中国の丸底の鍋から発展したが、正確な発明年は知られていない。鋳鉄製の家庭用中華鍋は宋代に一般的になり、炒め料理の中心的な調理器具となった。
